page: Microsoft Azure D4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server features 4 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled running at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The processor is equipped with 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 support, AES cryptography, and SHA extensions.

The instance is provisioned with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage capabilities include a bundled 236 GB local disk, and the virtual machine is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage. The hypervisor layer is managed by Microsoft Hyper-V. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type, and it does not contain any GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core tests placing in the top 25%. Text processing performance is also strong. However, multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores, falls into the average range. Memory bandwidth tests show some limitations, with read-only operations categorized as weak, while write operations for large blocks remain average. Cryptographic and physics simulations perform at average levels, whereas database operations and Redis SET operations show weaker performance.

Given its balanced CPU-to-memory ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the D4ads_v6 offers a cost-efficient entry point for general-purpose workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the premium cost of memory-optimized or compute-optimized tiers. It is well-suited for static web serving, single-threaded applications, and lightweight text processing. It is less optimal for memory-bound databases, multi-threaded compilation, or complex ray tracing tasks due to its lower memory bandwidth and weaker multi-threaded scaling in those specific areas.
description: The Microsoft Azure D4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Dadv6 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs running at 3.7 GHz. It features 16.0 GB of RAM and a bundled 236 GB local disk with Premium Storage capability. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this x86_64 instance delivers strong single-core CPU and text processing performance, though its multi-core scaling and memory read bandwidth are relatively weak. It provides a balanced, cost-efficient hardware profile for general-purpose workloads, making it suitable for static web serving, single-threaded tasks, and lightweight application hosting, while being less optimal for memory-intensive database operations or heavy multi-threaded compilation.
